provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code on the ring x^341 - 1 with a(x) = x^32 + x^61 + x^70 + x^202 + x^224 + x^238 + x^321 + x^323, b(x) = x^57 + x^98 + x^163 + x^210 + x^224 + x^232 + x^265 + x^269; H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T]. a and b are low-weight codewords of the ideal of a divisor of x^341 - 1 of degree 51, fixing k = 2 deg gcd(a, b, x^m - 1) = 102.
provenance.notes: Designed-divisor construction: the divisor is a product of cyclotomic-coset minimal polynomials over GF(2^ord_2(m)), so its degree and hence k are chosen rather than inherited, and a and b are drawn from its ideal by information-set decoding. Both single-block kernels have dimension 51 exactly, matching deg gcd(a, b, x^m - 1). The binding bound here is the orbit fold, not the general search: a 24-seed information-set gate at 2,000,000 trials each over 16,105 s bottoms at 86 with a per-seed spread of 86 to 93, while the fold over every equal-orbit partition of the 682 qubits returns a validated lift of weight 77 at 31 orbits of size 11. The claim is therefore 77 on X from the fold and 86 on Z from the gate. A single-block circulant search at 10 seeds x 600,000 trials finds nothing under 77. Both witnesses re-verified against these matrices.
